text:
maria: Alert from billing 70% of our S3 is fallback audit events. current sampling=50% from old test. we need a quick mitigation and a plan.
kevin: short-term: set global default to 10% and make sampling deterministic (hash req_id + policy salt). will push runtime change behind ff.
sasha: add severity override: ERROR/CRITICAL -> 100%. transient (timeouts/429) -> 5%. console should expose per-policy slider later.
omar: ops wants a backfill annotation so we can compute "would_have_sampled" on historical events before flipping defaults. low perf decorator ok.
ops-bot: checklist created: feature-flag sampling_v2, s3-ingest alarm, grafana panel for sampled_bytes and overlap metric.
maria: agreed. action items: kevin runtime PR tonight, sasha console mock by tomorrow, omar alert rule by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
